lines: Right side: the Rough Riders. Voss and his unit took the gear from our forward depot.
They called us the Fury crew like we were strangers. What happened to them?
HotWire and Phoenix warned us before their last mission. Neither has checked in since.
Then we get answers here. Right wing, on me.
